description: This file provides LDAP API functions for authentication, including connection, binding, user search, and attribute retrieval, used within the TestLink project.

methods.name: ldap_connect_bind
methods.description: Establishes and binds to an LDAP server using provided configuration and credentials.

methods.name: ldap_authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a user against LDAP servers by searching for the user and attempting to bind with their DN and password.

methods.name: ldap_escape_string
methods.description: Escapes special characters in LDAP strings to prevent injection.

methods.name: ldap_get_field_from_username
methods.description: Retrieves a specific LDAP attribute value for a given username.
